item.title: Swalwell announces resignation from Congress after sexual misconduct allegations torpedoed gubernatorial bid
item.summary: Rep. Eric Swalwell announced his resignation from Congress following a bombshell Chronicle report and the collapse of his California governor campaign.

item.title: Trump’s McDonald’s order comes with cash surprise for ‘DoorDash Grandma’ outside White House
item.summary: President Trump received a McDonald's delivery from a DoorDash driver in the Oval Office and tipped her $100 while promoting his no tax on tips policy.

item.title: Trump rejects American Bishop Robert Barron's call to apologize to Pope for 'disrespectful' comments
item.summary: President Trump rejects Bishop Barron's call to apologize to Pope Leo, arguing the Pope is wrong on Iran foreign policy and weak on crime issues.

item.title: Iran secures UN role with backing from UK, France, Canada, Australia as US stands alone
item.summary: Western democracies face backlash for allowing Iran and other authoritarian regimes to secure influential U.N. seats as the U.S. stood alone in opposition.

item.title: Illegal immigrant accused of Easter kidnapping, sex assault in college town; DHS rips second attack in weeks
item.summary: Federal authorities warn Missouri not to release an illegal immigrant accused of raping and kidnapping a woman in Kirksville on Easter Sunday.

item.title: Bahamas authorities race against deadline to charge or cut loose husband of missing American woman
item.summary: Bahamian authorities face a deadline to charge or release Brian Hooker as the search for missing Michigan boater Lynette Hooker shifts to recovery.

item.title: WATCH: Rowdy teenagers swarm DC Navy Yard in waterfront takeover despite police juvenile curfew zone
item.summary: D.C.'s Navy Yard saw another teen takeover this weekend, prompting a juvenile curfew zone and increased police presence to address ongoing disruptions.

item.title: Appeals court lets Trump resume White House ballroom construction, seeks lower court clarity
item.summary: The appeals court stayed their ruling from taking force through April 17, allowing the Trump administration to seek emergency intervention from the Supreme Court.

item.title: Butler man’s online rants to kill Trump end in guilty plea after FBI probe
item.summary: Shawn Monper pleaded guilty to making threats to assassinate President Trump and kill ICE agents in posts on YouTube, according to the Justice Department.

item.title: Mike Breen says fans 'deserve to be thrown a bone' as NBA cuts all local broadcasts from the playoffs
item.summary: New York Knicks and ESPN announcer Mike Breen ripped the NBA for removing local broadcasters from the playoffs for the first time in league history as part of the new TV rights deal.
